hook: Kate Crawford studies the social and material costs of artificial intelligence. She wrote Atlas of AI, published by Yale University Press in 2021, co-founded the AI Now Institute at NYU and the FATE group at Microsoft Research, and founded the Knowing Machines project. Her map Anatomy of an AI System, made with Vladan Joler, won the Beazley Design of the Year and is held by MoMA and the V&A.
